title: Extremal Effective Cycles and Nef Line Bundles on \(\overline{\rm{M}}_{g,n}\)
summary: There has been a growing body of work devoted to the study of effective cones of codimension-\(k\) cycles \(\text{Eff}^k(\overline{\rm{M}}_{g,n})\) on \(\overline{\rm{M}}_{g,n}\), the moduli space of \(n\) pointed stable curves of genus \(g\). In this paper, we remove the genus-dependence present in previous bounds on the number of marked points, and prove the following results: (1) \(\text{Eff}^k(\overline{\rm{M}}_{g,n})\) has infinitely many extremal rays for \(k\ge 2\), \(g\ge 3\) and \(n\ge 2k-2\), and (2) \(\text{Eff}^k(\overline{\rm{M}}_{g,n})\) is non-polyhedral for \(k\ge 2\), \(g\ge…
